task_spec.requirements: Fold the currently visible garment among tabletop distractors. Bring each sleeve inward toward the opposite chest, then both lower hem corners toward the corresponding shoulders, keeping hem and shoulder edges approximately parallel. Use current RGB garment edges and landmarks, not distractor edges or hidden garment nodes. Reobserve after each sleeve. Retain both hem corners through folding, lower and release both grippers before returning both arms home. Preserve public robot, finger and table clearance checks and the native 500-action budget.

qualification.scope: One first native layout per seed set; engineering admission, not full benchmark reliability
